prompt: A young human wizard in cerulean-blue robes with silver trim, seated at a cluttered oak study table strewn with open leather-bound tomes and inkpots. He faces three-quarter left, one hand raised as a single glowing parchment scroll spirals up into his palm from a tall open book, while his other hand lets a spent, dim grey page slip and flutter down toward the floor. Cerulean arcane light haloes the incoming page; the discarded page is dull and curling. The only source of light is the soft blue glow of the drawn scroll. The background is a dim candlelit library wall lined with bookshelves.

A young human wizard in deep sapphire-blue robes standing in side profile facing right, flinching and turning toward a bright cerulean spell-flash erupting off-frame to his right. The flash pulls a single glowing parchment page up off the open spellbook cradled in his left arm; the rising page is haloed in blue light, while a second spent page crumbles to grey ash falling from his right hand. The only source of light is the cerulean flash. The background is a shadowy stone arcane tower interior with a tall arched window.
